title: psychotria gabrieliae
intro: Psychotria gabrieliae, commonly known as Yohimbe, is a plant species native to Africa. Yohimbe has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to improve cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and act as an antidepressant. The bioactive constituents of Yohimbe include alkaloids, such as yohimbine, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation and stimulation of the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Yohimbe include its ability to enhance mood, reduce fatigue, and improve sexual function, making it a popular ingredient in herbal supplements.
